description: MoinPDF uses the worker only for one-shot conversion. Preserve ordinary headless event dispatch and honor verbose=false, as the upstream Node converter does. Original corresponding source remains in MATBEE-SOURCES; these exact replacements are applied by scripts/prepare-office-assets.mjs.

replacements.description: LibreOfficeKit initializes its own headless application. Prevent Emscripten from also starting the full soffice main function on a pthread: it races with Kit initialization and document export.
Do not activate synchronous keyboard/mouse editing events during document import/export.
replacements.before: c.enableSyncEvents(),console.log("[LOK Worker] Enabled synchronous event dispatch (Unipoll mode)")

replacements.description: Honor the supplied verbose flag for LibreOffice stdout and stderr; no synthetic document contents are written to the browser console in normal use.
Keep warnings enabled without forcing all LibreOffice diagnostic categories.
Keep the diagnostic label consistent with the changed setting.
